product_intent: A small desktop-sized storage box with a hinged lid that remains closed until manually released by a user's thumb

clauses.text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid.
The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb.
The box should be safe to use, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.

requirements.statement: The storage box must have a hinged lid that remains closed until manually released by a user's thumb

verification.observable: The lid remains closed until thumb pressure is applied to release it
verification.condition: User applies thumb pressure to lid

requirements.statement: The storage box must be safe to use

verification.observable: No sharp edges, toxic materials, or hazardous components

requirements.statement: The storage box must be easy to assemble

verification.observable: Assembly instructions and component fitment requirements

requirements.statement: The storage box must be practical to manufacture

verification.observable: Manufacturing process feasibility and cost effectiveness

requirements.statement: The storage box must be desktop-sized
The storage box must operate manually only

verification.observable: Operation without external power or mechanical assistance

requirements.statement: The storage box must be designed for additive manufacturing

verification.observable: Design compatibility with additive manufacturing processes

operating_scenarios.name: Normal Operation
operating_scenarios.description: User places items in the storage box and closes the lid manually until release by thumb pressure

operating_scenarios.name: Safe Use Environment
operating_scenarios.description: Product is used in typical desktop environments without hazards

operating_scenarios.name: Assembly Process
operating_scenarios.description: Product is assembled by a user following standard assembly procedures

operating_scenarios.name: Manufacturing Environment
operating_scenarios.description: Product is manufactured using additive manufacturing techniques

declared_absent.freedoms: No explicit freedoms were declared in the request or clarifications
declared_absent.relations: No conflicting, dependent, refining, or duplicating requirements identified
declared_absent.unknowns: No unknown quantities or information gaps found in the stated requirements
